name: resume-session
description: Locate, read, and resume past agent sessions on this machine: Claude Code, Codex (including codex://threads/<id> deeplinks), Antigravity (AGY), Muse Code, Cursor, Grok, or repo handover files. Renders a session as a numbered transcript, reads it in full when the reader's context holds it or fans out one subagent per chunk with the braindump extraction method, and writes a takeover briefing: a pinned block of constraints, corrections, dead ends and exact identifiers, then the 6D state.
